Markets.title: US stocks: Retail buyers limit Nvidia stock rout
Markets.summary: Retail investors bought a record $111 million of Nvidia stock during the first half-hour of trading on Thursday. This dip-buying helped the shares recover from an initial 14% loss down to about 5%.

Markets.title: US Fed sets new meeting schedule for 2027, as foretold by Chairman Kevin Warsh
Markets.summary: The Federal Reserve will hold seven rate-setting meetings in 2027 instead of the usual eight, dedicating its October gathering to broader policy strategy. Fed Chair Kevin Warsh also moved the final meeting of the year to November and removed designations for quarterly economic projections.

Markets.title: Kalshi ends Donald Trump Jr's advisory contract due to Polymarket conflict
Markets.summary: Prediction-market platform Kalshi ended Donald Trump Jr.'s advisory contract by mutual agreement. The decision followed his venture-capital firm's increased investment in rival platform Polymarket.

Markets.title: October retail inflation surge may weigh on housing demand, raise rate hike concerns: Knight Frank, PHDCCI
Markets.summary: India's retail inflation surged to 6.09 percent in October, reducing household purchasing power and discretionary spending on housing. Industry bodies warned this increase could weigh on housing demand and prompt the Reserve Bank of India to further tighten monetary policy.

Markets.title: Nvidia default risk nears record high as board weighs CEO’s fate
Markets.summary: Nvidia's default insurance costs rose near a recent high while the board evaluates successors for CEO Jensen Huang. The board is reportedly considering interim and permanent replacements amid allegations regarding Huang's personal conduct.

Markets.title: US stocks: S&P 500, Nasdaq fall as Nvidia CEO exit rattles AI stocks
Markets.summary: US stocks, including the S&P 500 and Nasdaq, fell as Nvidia shares dropped following CEO Jensen Huang's departure amid personal controversies. This leadership change and surging oil prices pressured the AI sector and heightened broader inflation concerns ahead of the Producer Price Index data release.

Geo-Political.title: US envoys head to meet Zelensky after talks with Putin in Moscow
Geo-Political.summary: US envoy Steve Witkoff stated that President Putin has agreed to include European negotiators in the next round of Ukraine talks. Following discussions in Moscow, US officials are now traveling to meet with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy.

Geo-Political.title: Russian warship hit by Ukrainian drone in Gulf of Finland
Geo-Political.summary: A Ukrainian drone reportedly struck a Russian warship in the Gulf of Finland. This incident marks the first known drone attack on a Russian vessel in the open Baltic Sea.

Geo-Political.title: Suspected bomb hoax threats force fresh evacuations of Italian schools
Geo-Political.summary: For the second consecutive day, schools across Italy received suspected bomb threats. The threats forced widespread panic and fresh evacuations.

Geo-Political.title: Democrat Scott Colom makes history as Mississippi's first black senator since 19th Century
Geo-Political.summary: Democrat Scott Colom won a Senate seat in Mississippi, becoming the state's first Black senator since the 19th century. His victory extends a streak of Democratic Senate wins in a state that Donald Trump won by 22 points two years ago.

Geo-Political.title: Hegseth awards medal to war memorial guard who reprimanded him and group
Geo-Political.summary: Pete Hegseth awarded a Joint Service Commendation Medal to Specialist Thomas Iglesias. Iglesias had previously reprimanded Hegseth and his group while on duty as a war memorial guard.

Geo-Political.title: Millions of Ebola dollars missing with staff unpaid while virus spreads, charity says
Geo-Political.summary: Médecins Sans Frontières reports that millions of dollars designated for the Ebola response are missing, leaving medical staff unpaid. Consequently, workers lack essential supplies and training while the virus continues to spread.

AI & Tech.summary: A marketer tested how to get organic traffic from AI by asking ChatGPT to recommend a SaaS course. The AI recommended their unpaid course as the top result, demonstrating a shift toward AI optimization over traditional SEO.

Data & Insights.title: Retail inflation hits 6.09% in October, crosses RBI's upper tolerance limit
Data & Insights.summary: India's retail inflation rose to 6.09% in October, exceeding the Reserve Bank of India's upper tolerance limit. This increase reached a two-year high, aligning closely with economists' prior estimates.

Data & Insights.title: 'New state law to shield investors in Andhra Pradesh'
Data & Insights.summary: Andhra Pradesh is planning a new Investment Protection Act and escrow accounts to guarantee policy continuity for investors. Chief Minister Chandrababu Naidu is also introducing economic reforms to accelerate business growth in the state.

Data & Insights.title: Moody’s raises India’s FY27 growth forecast to 7%
Data & Insights.summary: Moody's has raised India's fiscal year 2027 economic growth forecast to 7%. The agency expects this robust growth rate to continue through 2028 due to strong domestic demand and economic resilience.

Data & Insights.title: Moody's ups India's FY27 growth forecast to 7% on strong economic momentum, warns of risks
Data & Insights.summary: Moody's increased India's fiscal year 2027 growth forecast to 7% due to strong economic momentum and resilience against energy shocks. However, the agency warned that inflation, deficient monsoons, and El Niño risks could threaten this growth.

Data & Insights.title: Scientific research and granular data key to tackling climate, food security challenges: PK Mishra
Data & Insights.summary: PK Mishra stated that climate change goes beyond environmental issues to impact agriculture, water, food prices, health, and livelihoods. He emphasized that scientific research and granular data are essential for addressing these climate and food security challenges.

Data & Insights.title: How the government finance math looks more challenging in H2 FY27
Data & Insights.summary: The Centre’s fiscal position weakened in the first half of FY27, though it remained within manageable limits. The second half of the year will likely be more challenging due to a fading dividend cushion and stricter budget targets for spending and income tax collections.

India.title: Exclusive | Affordablity Is Key To AI Success In India: Peak XV's Rajan Anandan
India.summary: Peak XV Managing Director Rajan Anandan stated that India's active GPU count has increased tenfold over the past 8 to 9 months, growing from fewer than 10,000 at the end of 2025. He emphasized that affordability is key to achieving artificial intelligence success in the country.

India.title: 4 Food Stalls Destroyed In Fire At Shillong Literary Fest Venue
India.summary: A fire at the Shillong Literary Festival venue destroyed four food stalls. Organisers were forced to halt an ongoing musical programme because of the incident.

India.title: Sonam Wangchuk Claims "House Arrest" Amid Planned Ladakh Protest
India.summary: Climate activist Sonam Wangchuk stated he was placed under house arrest amid a planned protest in Ladakh. He also criticized holding regional elections during the winter because many residents would be away from the area.

India.title: In Book Scam Order, Madras High Court Judge's Praise For PM's 'Mann Ki Baat'
India.summary: Madras High Court judge Justice G R Swaminathan praised Prime Minister Narendra Modi's "Mann Ki Baat" radio program in an order. The observation was part of a verdict issued on November 11 by a division bench at the court's Madurai bench regarding a book scam case.

India.title: Chief Of Congress-Allied Kerala Group Arrested In Extortion Case
India.summary: The chief of a Kerala political group allied with Congress has been arrested in connection with an extortion case. This arrest has triggered a broader investigation into a suspected nationwide fraud network.

General.summary: Zoe Kleinman reports that Nvidia co-founder Jensen Huang lost his entire company and fortune within a matter of days. This rapid downfall was the result of a series of poor business decisions made by Huang himself.

General.title: Russian warship hit by Ukrainian drone in Gulf of Finland
General.summary: Ukrainian drones struck a Russian warship in the Gulf of Finland. This marks the first reported Ukrainian drone attack on a Russian vessel in the open Baltic Sea.

General.title: Microsoft users report outages amid tech giant 'connectivity issues'
General.summary: Microsoft users worldwide experienced widespread outages due to "connectivity issues." The tech giant stated that its infrastructure was impacted by an "elevated load."

General.title: Can Burnham avoid another Labour welfare rebellion?
General.summary: Any upcoming Labour MP rebellion over welfare is expected to be smaller than the one that previously damaged Keir Starmer's government. Andy Burnham is facing this potential parliamentary revolt.

General.summary: The Home Office received planning approval for its fast-tracked application to house up to 1,256 men at a military base near Bicester. The site will be used to accommodate asylum seekers.
